elements.label: Figure A10
elements.title: MS Excel’s Bar Chart Icon (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of the Excel interface showing the Insert tab selected, with the Bar Chart dropdown open and the Clustered Column icon highlighted with a red circle. Visible are other ribbon options like Home, Draw, Page Layout, Formulas, Data, Review, View, and Add-ins. Also visible is part of a spreadsheet with columns labeled Name, Team, Position, Height(inches), Weight(pounds), Age.
elements.summary: This figure demonstrates how to locate and select the Clustered Column bar chart icon within the Insert tab of MS Excel to create a bar chart.
